products.name: Starter kit
contents: The camera kit: 9 pieces, 2 spares, the pinhole ring and disc, the printed build guide, the card
1 roll of colour film: ISO 400, 24 pictures

products.name: Camera kit
contents: The 9 pieces: body, back, front plate, shutter, aperture wheel, spool, wind knob, frame wheel, lens
2 spares: a shutter and a wind knob
For the pinhole experiment: the pinhole ring and a pinhole disc (thin metal, laser-drilled 0.25 mm hole)
The printed build guide, 16 small pages

contents: 1 roll of colour film: ISO 400, 24 pictures

contents: 3 rolls of colour film: ISO 400, 24 pictures

contents: Developing and scanning for one roll

products.name: Negatives back
contents: The negatives of one roll posted back to you, if asked for within 30 days

products.name: A set of small prints
contents: One 4 x 6 inch print of each of twelve frames

products.name: The proof sheet
contents: All twelve frames of a proof roll on one 8 x 10 inch print

products.name: Black-and-white pack

products.name: Near ring
contents: One thin ring (0.4 mm) that goes under the lens
Sets the camera for 1.5 m: at the small dot, sharp from 0.7 m to far away

products.name: Pinhole discs, five
contents: Five thin metal discs, 10.5 mm across, each with a laser-drilled 0.25 mm hole
One goes in the lens pocket, under the pinhole ring, in place of the lens
